message:
nrUE: align negative sync offsets with the next frame

Initial synchronization can return a negative rx_offset. syncInFrame() consumes no samples for negative offsets, leaving reception misaligned and causing repeated PBCH decoding failures.

Advance negative offsets by one frame and increment the decoded frame number.

Signed-off-by: Adrian-Cristian Batrin <(contact: see the repository README)>
title: nrUE: align negative sync offsets with the next frame
